name: Lyo.Law.Models
tagline: Request and response types, enums, and route constants for state statutes.
description: Wire types for the state statute API. Jurisdictions are US states. A code is one named compilation inside a state. Nodes are the outline and the text. This package has no DI registration. Federal law is not a type in this package.
features: Enums for node kind and annotation kind. Node text is stored as text.
`Constants.Rest.Law` route prefixes, including the source-key upsert and citation lookup.
